title: R0 · Calibrated existing layout
assessment: Control view: R1 layout, now with manufacturer seat/back height corrections.

title: A · Layered warm family
assessment: Recommended starting direction: add useful storage, entry bench, side table and reading light while keeping straight sofa and open centre.

title: B · Compact chaise family lounge
assessment: More relaxed lounging and higher occupied footprint. Generic 2880 × 1545 composition, not a verified Muuto SKU. Inspect sofa-to-coffee and coffee-to-TV gaps before selection.

title: C · Soft sculptural, reversed TV wall
assessment: More expressive cocoon silhouette with television west and sofa east. Tests a real change in visual hierarchy; Marenco is an aesthetic reference only. Fixed 42° views allow a fair comparison.

title: Kitchen A · Pale oak working L
assessment: Dedicated 1000 mm prep section; sink and adjacent dishwasher; west cooking run; south fridge and shallow landing. Open-appliance envelopes are separately checked. Appliance choices and plumbing are TBD.

title: Kitchen B · Muted olive working L
assessment: Same working geometry as kitchen A, alternative quieter olive cabinet finish. Pale worktop concept with Dekton Aeris as real material reference, not a specified installation.

title: Bathroom A · Retain family bathtub
assessment: Retain ensuite 1500 × 750 tub and family 900 × 900 shower; complete closed towel storage. Existing drainage, falls and ventilation remain TBD.

title: Bathroom B · Ensuite walk-in shower study
assessment: Exploratory replacement of movable bathtub fixture with generous shower; walls and bathroom door unchanged. Wet-area engineering and actual shower screen specification not yet approved.
